title: The bridge to agent-scale Git infrastructure
summary: Busy repos couldn't take cross-region quorum latency, so Spokes moves write serialization from repository to reference.

title: From latency to instant: Modernizing GitHub Issues navigation performance
summary: Cuts redundant fetches on issue navigations by rendering from a preheated stale-while-revalidate IndexedDB cache.

title: How we improved push processing on GitHub
summary: Splits RepositoryPushJob, a sequential job unsafe to retry, into Kafka-fed jobs that each retry and fail on their own.

title: Upgrading GitHub.com to MySQL 8.0
summary: Keeps MySQL 8.0 upgrades reversible by fixing the collation defaults and role grants that broke replication to 5.7.

title: The technology behind GitHub’s new code search
summary: Replaces slow, costly general text search with Blackbird, a Rust ngram index sharded by blob SHA to skip duplicates.

title: Scaling Git’s garbage collection
summary: Prevents loose-object explosions during Git GC by packing unreachable objects into cruft packs with per-object mtimes.

title: Improve Git monorepo performance with a file system monitor
summary: Avoids rescanning a monorepo's worktree on every git status by asking the FSMonitor daemon what changed since a token.

title: A brief history of code search at GitHub
summary: Replaces Elasticsearch code search, which dropped punctuation and missed substrings, with the Rust engine Blackbird.

title: Partitioning GitHub’s relational databases to handle scale
summary: Splits the main MySQL cluster, where any incident hit every feature, into schema domains kept apart by SQL linters.

title: How we scaled the GitHub API with a sharded, replicated rate limiter in Redis
summary: Stops wobbling reset times and expired windows on Redis replicas by storing reset-at in its own key.

title: Debugging network stalls on Kubernetes
summary: Traces packet stalls to RX softirqs stuck behind memory.stat reads slowed by zombie cgroups, then upgrades the kernel.

title: MySQL High Availability at GitHub
summary: Replaces split-brain-prone VIPs and slow DNS in MySQL failover with orchestrator/raft publishing primaries via Consul.
